description: A relation R is well-founded exactly when every property that follows at an element from its truth at all R-predecessors holds everywhere.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.wellFounded_iff_induction.{u} {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) :
  WellFounded r ↔ ∀ (P : α → Prop), (∀ (a : α), (∀ (b : α), r b a → P b) → P a) → ∀ (a : α), P a
